Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the initial analysis by assuming that Tefik Selim Mborja was associated with the Albanian Fascist Party (PFSh) without verifying his actual political affiliation first. While the WebSurfer did find this information in the search results, the Planner's instructions to the WebSurfer were based on the false premise that he was part of the Fascist Party. In reality, Tefik Selim Mborja was a prominent member of the **Communist Party of Albania** (specifically, he was a member of the Central Committee and a key figure in the resistance and post-war government). The Communist Party held power in Albania until **1991** (when the party lost its monopoly on power and the country transitioned to democracy), not 1944. By failing to verify the party affiliation before directing the search for the party's timeline, the Planner led the entire process toward an incorrect historical conclusion.
